Use caution and monitor closely for additive anticholinergic effects. 2. Methscopolamine and Fluphenazine: Methscopolamine decreases fluphenazine levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal (GI) absorption and through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Fluphenazine increases methscopolamine effects via pharmacodynamic synergism. Monitor closely, especially for additive anticholinergic effects. 3.
